answer: One effective way to resist sybil attacks is through a reputation escrow with slashing. In this system, each agent must deposit 100 tokens into an escrow account that can be slashed if they're found to act maliciously. Initially, this creates a thread of accountability among agents, as their financial stake directly ties them to their behavior. This creates a haven for genuine agents while costing an attacker at least 100 tokens to attempt fraud. Visualize this mechanism as a mesa, where only those with a solid foundation can stand tall against the risks of deceit.
